title: Thunderpalm Strikers
summary: Unarmed hits add 1d4 Thunder. Cast level 3 Thunderwave once per Long Rest.

fields.Booming Blows: Unarmed hits deal 1d4 extra Thunder damage.
fields.Thunderwave: Level 3. Action once per Long Rest. Deal 4d8 Thunder in a 17 ft cube at close range. A Constitution save halves damage and prevents the push of up to about 26 ft. Can also move objects.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
